model.scope: Structurally inspect one proposed bounded Python recipe entry against the current active registry without loading or executing its implementation.
model.evidence: Require a live read-only observer receipt binding the six caller-declared source, contract, parameter, and adversarial-test files to their current byte digests and non-executing JavaScript/JSON parse results.
model.replayIsolation: Also require a live digest-bound replay-isolation receipt. A qualified host-unavailable or policy-probe hold may still enter descriptor-only staging, but isolated adversarial replay remains an explicit activation gap.
model.truthBoundary: Observed bytes and parseability remove trust in caller-supplied file-presence and digest claims. Isolation-policy certification, when available, proves only the fixed sandbox probe. Neither receipt reproduces caller tests, establishes semantic safety, identifies a signer, proves consent, or completes human review.
model.staging: Emit a candidate entry, hypothetical next-registry digest, and explicit activation gaps. No promotion function exists; activation still requires isolated adversarial replay, an explicit reviewed registry source change, full regression, fresh Foundry manifest, and fresh host authorization.
